artworks.title: The Exodus from Egypt
artworks.artist: Jan Sadeler I, after Maarten van Cleef
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large group of people carrying various objects and preparing for a journey. The scene is busy with activity as people are laden with items. The landscape features a hilly background with a procession of people continuing into the distance. The artistic style employs fine, detailed lines typical of engravings, showcasing intricate detailing of clothing and expressions. This image captures a moment of organized chaos, where individuals are actively engaged in the logistics of movement.

artworks.title: The Crossing of the Red Sea
artworks.artist: Johan Wierix, after Maarten van Cleef
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene depicting a chariot drawn by horses surrounded by turbulent waters and clouds. The central figure is falling from the chariot with a distressed expression as swirling waves rise around them. To one side, multiple figures and spears push forward, highlighting the chaos. The horses show tension and motion, with expressive eyes and flared nostrils as they struggle against the forces. Large, ominous clouds fill the sky, with weapons scattered amidst the waves, adding to the sense of conflict and urgency.

artworks.title: A Seated Man Contemplating a Sunlit Mountain Valley
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Joan and David Maxwell
artworks.description: The image shows a valley surrounded by mountains, with cliffs blocking the horizon. The painting has loose brushstrokes in an impressionistic style, using a muted color palette. Vegetation is depicted in various greens, while rocks are shown in browns and grays. The sky is a pale color. A figure in dark clothing is seated on a slope, looking at the landscape, with trees and shrubs around them. Further away, there are cliffs with greenery, creating a dramatic backdrop.

artworks.title: Jan van den Enden
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of a person from the chest up, featuring a focus on the face and headwear. The individual faces slightly to the right, with a direct gaze. Their facial features are detailed, with a smooth complexion and full lips, along with long, wavy hair flowing down past the shoulders. The hair is drawn with flowing lines for texture. The person wears a large, wide-brimmed hat casting a shadow, adding a dramatic touch to the portrait. A garment with buttons can be seen under the hat. The background is plain, emphasizing the subject.

artworks.title: Dead Scottish Soldiers on the Battlefield near Ypres
artworks.medium: watercolor with pen and black ink on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Fund
artworks.description: This is a painting of a surreal woodland scene with abstract elements. The painting depicts an area in a forest setting with three unknown forms on a shadowed ground. Vibrant colors such as blues, browns, and greens are used in a loose and expressive manner. The background features tree trunks and various shaped forms, suggesting a natural environment rendered with an abstract and expressive approach.

artworks.title: Hölzfaller (recto)
artworks.medium: watercolor with pen and black ink on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image shows swirling lines and bold shapes in a mix of vivid colors. In the center, interwoven blue lines create a figure-like silhouette with outstretched limbs. To the left, brown sinuous forms resemble large clawed hands or roots. The background consists of smoky grays and reds, suggesting movement and chaos. The composition suggests a struggle or interaction between recognizable forms resembling an embrace or tussle.

artworks.title: Timoleon Thanked by the Citizens of Syracuse
artworks.medium: black chalk on pale green wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered around a central seated figure indoors. The drawing features a multitude of figures rendered in delicate pencil lines. The central part of the composition includes a seated figure with an outstretched arm, positioned in front of a group of standing and seated figures. In the background, architectural elements such as columns and arches suggest an indoor setting. The details are often sketchy and indistinct, contributing to an impression of movement and interaction within the group.

artworks.title: Sailboats in a Sunlit Harbor  (recto)
artworks.description: The image depicts a coastal scene with sailboats on the water in front of a building. The horizon is marked by the meeting of water and distant structures. A building with a red roof stands out against a soft sky. Loose watercolor brushstrokes create a light and spontaneous feel. The color palette includes earth tones and pastels such as grays, browns, and blues. Sailboats with bright yellow and red accents are in the foreground, set against a serene backdrop of hills and water.

artworks.title: Auguste III. Roi de Pologne
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in a stately posture, with a composed expression and detailed armor. He is holding a baton. Next to him, there is a figure holding a helmet, wearing a turban. The background features trees and foliage.

artworks.title: L'Optique (The Optical Viewer)
artworks.medium: etching and wash manner, printed in black
artworks.description: Printed with soft gray and black on cream-white paper, a woman and young boy stand in front of a square table set with papers and a looking device in this vertical etching. The boy and woman stand angled to our left at the center of the composition, and both have wide-set eyes and delicate noses. Both smile with bow-shaped lips. The woman turns her face to look at us. Long hair is partially arranged in bands of curls under her hat, which has elaborate bows. The bodice of her dress fits tightly on the long sleeves and to the narrow waist, and fabric is gathered and tucked into the puffy neckline. Her skirt flares out at the waist and falls in deep, crinkling folds to the ground. The woman reaches across the boy to hold the corner of one sheet of paper in the stack on the table. The boy has shaggy, dark hair, and he looks at the device. He wears a jacket over a ruffled shirt. The hand we see rests on the edge of the velvety cloth covering the table. The wooden device is on a stand with turned knobs like a candlestick. A vertically oriented rectangular panel frames a round window. A second panel hinges from the top edge of the first to angle up and to our left, presumably reflecting or mirroring images on the papers below. A brass and stone candlestick and a glass cup sit on a brown stone mantle behind the table to our left. Those objects and the paneling of the room behind us are reflected in a mirror over the mantle. A stringed, guitar-like instrument leans against one arm a chair standing just behind the woman’s legs. A curtain hangs from the top right corner of the sheet to drape across the back of the chair and partially cover a high wooden chest. An open book, a closed book, papers, and urn are arranged against the dark wall atop the chest. Text printed in cursive under the lower left image of the image reads, “Peint par L Boillly.” Text to the right reads, “Gravé par F. Cazenave.” The title, “L’Optique,” is printed among curlicues in the center of the lower margin, and beneath that text reads, “A Paris chez l’Auteur, Rue Jacques No. 13. en face de la rue de la Parcheminerie. Imprimé par Finot.”

artworks.title: The Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: The image shows several figures in motion. In the center, a person with curly hair is guiding a donkey while pointing ahead. On the donkey, there is a woman with a headscarf holding a child. Other figures are also present, some holding onto goats and sheep, in a rocky landscape. The central figure holds a staff. The background has rough rock formations and contrasting light and shadows.

artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and brush and brown wash, heightened with white, on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with figures and a landscape. It is viewed from a slightly elevated perspective, showing the horizon towards the upper part, with a structure in the distance. A group of figures, including a seated man, woman, and child, are depicted in the foreground. The sunlight illuminates them. The brushstrokes are expressive and fluid, with a textured style. The color palette includes earthy browns and whites. A donkey is grazing in the distance, contributing to the rural atmosphere. The artwork presents a balance between figures and nature, capturing a tranquil moment.

artworks.title: Portrait of Two Illinois Cavalrymen
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image features a vintage portrait of two individuals standing side by side. Both persons have short hair and wear military uniforms with dark coats, gold trim, and buttons. They wear hats tilted to the side and hold swords - one rested on the ground and the other by their side. The individuals have neutral expressions and appear youthful. The backdrop is plain, and the portrait is enclosed in a decorative golden frame.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man and Girl with Horse and Dog
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man and a child, both visible from the waist up. The man is seated on a chair, facing forward with his left arm resting on the armrest and a dog lying across his lap. He has a stern expression, with short hair and he is wearing a cap. His attire consists of a dark vest over a light shirt, and there appears to be a necktie or bow tie around his collar. Beside him stands a young girl, who has her hair neatly parted in the middle and pulled back. She is dressed in a checkered dress, and holds a small object in her hands. In the background, a large horse stands behind them, with its head turned to the side. The setting seems to be indoors, with a plain backdrop placed behind the subjects. The image is housed in a decorative gilded frame that encompasses the entire photograph.

artworks.title: Portrait of a USCT Private
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man's upper body. He is seated, facing the camera directly, with a serious expression. The man has dark, curly hair and is wearing a dark hat, jacket, and light-colored scarf. He is holding a firearm in his right hand and the photograph is framed in gold with floral designs.

artworks.title: Water Dock and Brambles at a Sluice
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with detailed elements viewed from a ground-level perspective. It includes large leafy plants and tall grasses near a small pond or body of water with bubbles or ripples. An old tree trunk with roots and vines is on the right. In the distance, there is a wooden structure that may be a gate or sluice. The horizon is high with a softly shaded sky and cloud formations. The artwork is in black and white with intricate cross-hatching, creating depth and texture.

artworks.title: Rebel Works in Front of Atlanta, GA, No. 4
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows two cannons positioned on rough, earthy terrain. Next to them is a small tent where three individuals are seated. The ground is worn with wooden planks scattered around. In the distance, a soldier is sitting on a mound, facing away with a rifle over his shoulder. Beyond him are trees along the horizon, under a sky filled with clouds. The photo has a monochrome color palette, giving it a historical feel.

artworks.title: Cascade Lake, Adirondacks
artworks.creditLine: Diana and Mallory Walker Fund and Veverka Family Foundation Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a view from the edge of a lake, looking into the distance where the water narrows between forested mountain slopes. The horizon is obscured by the mountains that frame the scene. The composition has a sepia-toned palette, giving it a monochromatic appearance. In the foreground, there is a grassy bank with a boulder on the left, and a small boat with two individuals on the calm water. The reflections of trees and slopes are mirrored in the lake, creating a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Theodore Ferris, Yale University
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing. He has a beard, mustache, and dark hair under a flat cap. He wears a dark coat, matching waistcoat, white shirt, dark necktie, light-colored trousers, and dark shoes. He carries a bag with "YALE CONFECTIONERY" on it and holds a woven basket. The background is a simple studio setting with a plain wall, faint plant-like decorations, and a wooden panel at the bottom.

artworks.title: A Group of Angels in Glory
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink, pricked for transfer
artworks.description: The drawing shows cherubic figures ascending towards the heavens. It depicts several cherubs floating amongst clouds and celestial beams. Each cherub is drawn with simple, fluid lines. The use of line work creates a sense of movement as the cherubs appear to be ascending towards rays of light from above. The overall composition has a harmonious and uplifting ambiance, with the cherubic figures evoking a sense of divinity and purity.

artworks.title: A Group of Angels in Glory
artworks.artist: Italian 17th Century, after Guido Reni, after Luca Cambiaso
artworks.description: This drawing depicts winged cherubs ascending through clouds. The image shows several cherubs with child-like bodies and feathered wings flying upwards. They are arranged in a dynamic composition suggesting movement and ascent. The cherubs are depicted without clothing and with curly hair, surrounded by voluminous clouds in the background. The use of line work and shading gives the figures and clouds a sense of volume and realism.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man, Yale University
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated, holding a broom with one hand and a wicker basket with the other. He is wearing a textured hat, a ribbed sweater over a collared shirt, trousers, and worn shoes. There is a chair with ornate detailing and a curtain with large tassels in the background.

artworks.title: The Skeletons
artworks.description: This is a drawing of skeletons and draped figures in a cave-like setting. The composition shows figures in various poses; some are standing, while others are crouched or seated. Central to the image is a winged skeleton engaging with other figures. This skeletal figure holds a large book open. Around this central figure, human forms with clear musculature stand intertwined with twisted, bare trees and rocky outcrops. The figures express a range of emotions through their gestures and facial expressions. The detailed linework and shading emphasize the contrast between the skeletal forms and the living, both human and mythical.
